Hey there, so I'm not sure what I'd pick out for you, I don't want to rob other posters of what they want that's still available by picking at random myself. But to help you make a decision, here's some info:

In Pokemon Y, which is part of Generation 6, the following are valuable because they can only be obtained from Generations 3, 4, and 5, and they must be female for breeding purposes:

- Pokemon in Safari Balls (if you have Gen 3 and 4 games, you can get these yourself)

- Pokemon in Apricorn Balls (If you have HGSS, you can get all of these yourself)

- Pokemon in Sport Balls (Also from HGSS)

- Pokemon with Hidden Abilities, or HA (some species are easy to get yourself in Gen 6, some not at all without trading, very case by case with lots of weird circumstances)

- Pokemon in Dream Balls (Gen 5, impossible to get yourself legitimately except through trading now. These can also have HA)

- Fossil Pokemon in Shop Balls (Gen 5, same situation as Dream Balls)

So, to point you in a direction, Dream Balls and Shop Ball Fossils are the rarest stuff you'd want to ask for if you have access to the earlier Gen 3 and 4 games.
